title: awi-television-championship
label: “The Olympian” Gary White

won.source: White's own Explosion promo: he states he won the TV title from a wrestler referred to only as “McGirl” and has defended it three times since; the title-winning match itself is not a document this collection holds.

how: Won from a wrestler referred to only as “McGirl”; the match is not narrated in a held document.
note: No event link: the title-winning match is not narrated in any document this collection holds. Successfully defended at Explosion (28 Jul 1995) against “The Suplexmaster” Jake Perkins by submission, with interference.

title: awi-world-tag-team-championship
label: Megaton

won.source: Both held documents recap the win at the AWI Union supercard: Explosion's own opening video shows an unconscious Giant Titan and a wrestler its narration garbles as “the Jammer” at Union as Megaton is crowned; Mission Control has an archeologist congratulate Megaton on-air “on your victory at AWI UNION.” Union itself is not a document this collection holds.

how: Won the titles at the Union supercard; the corpus's own recap footage names one fallen former champion as Giant Titan and gestures at a partner it garbles as “the Jammer,” not confidently resolved to a former-holder team name by this pass (Giant Titan reappears three weeks later on an unrelated team, the Super Titans, with a different partner).
note: Event not linked: Union is recapped in both documents, not itself a document this collection holds. Former-holder identity is not confidently resolved (see ‘how’).

title: awi-north-american-championship
label: War Machine

won.source: Mission Control's own courtroom segment recaps the match by exact date: “let's go back to July 18 and the Union. Jack Fury was facing War Machine for the AWI North American Championship.” The match itself is not a document this collection holds.

how: Defeated Jack Fury for the title at the Union supercard.
note: Event not linked: Union is recapped, not itself a held document. Jack Fury is separately stated to have held the UWA version of the title before AWI's own founding merger.

title: awi-world-heavyweight-championship
label: D.A. Bookthrower

won.source: Mission Control (13 Aug 1995) names him the sitting champion via a framed ringside portrait and courtroom dialogue; neither held document narrates how or when he won the title, only that he already holds it by this date.

how: Not narrated in a held document; already champion by 13 Aug 1995.
note: Event not linked and won-date approximate: this pass's own two documents establish only a terminus ante quem (already champion by 13 Aug 1995), never the title win itself.
